key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large language model–based clinical AI system designed to turn fragmented musculoskeletal data into continuous, evidence-based management decisions across the full care pathway.
clinical_relevance: In orthopaedic and rehabilitation settings, it may help clinicians make more consistent longitudinal decisions, improve management planning, and support patient access to information.
method: Integrated real-time hospital data with external authoritative medical knowledge
Autonomously retrieved imaging, laboratory, pathology, and order data to update patient state
Benchmarked against specialist-reviewed EHR cases, then tested in reader, prospective, and randomized deployment studies
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmarking across 1,000 disease codes, a reader study with 81 orthopaedic physicians, a prospective study of 1,870 complex cases, and an 8-month randomized deployment in 8,240 inpatients showing improved performance and throughput.
watch_item: Results come from a specialized musculoskeletal system, so generalizability, workflow integration, and safety outside the studied settings still need careful validation.
